exposure: Timing of methadone maintenance therapy (MMT) initiation during pregnancy
outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
Removal from mother's custody at hospital discharge
cohort: 1842 pregnant women on MMT during pregnancy, eligible for public drug benefits in Ontario, Canada between 2005 and 2015
finding: While timing of methadone initiation during pregnancy was not significantly associated with most key perinatal adverse health outcomes, infants of mothers who initiated methadone during pregnancy had up to a fourfold increase in the odds of removal by social services at hospital discharge.
